{{Top|leg}}
'''Physical science droids''' were one of the four primary subgroups of [[Class one droid/Legends|class one droid]]s, along with [[biological science droid]]s and [[mathematics droid]]s. Physical science [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were designed for and tasked with the study of galactic physical phenomena and the testing of new scientific theories. A wide variety of scientific disciplines utilized physical science droids, such as [[Astronomer/Legends|astronomy]], physics, [[hyperphysics]], transdimensional quantum metaphysics, [[geology]], and chemistry.<ref name="TNEGD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
